measureDefinitions.name: Complaint Count
measureDefinitions.description: Sum imported complaint frequencies in current context; empty is zero.

measureDefinitions.name: Timely Yes Count
measureDefinitions.description: Sum imported complaint frequencies in current context; empty is zero.

measureDefinitions.name: Untimely No Count
measureDefinitions.description: Sum imported complaint frequencies in current context; empty is zero.

measureDefinitions.name: Unknown Flag Count
measureDefinitions.description: Sum imported complaint frequencies in current context; empty is zero.

measureDefinitions.name: Known Flag Count
measureDefinitions.description: Exact recorded Yes plus No flags; excludes unknown flags.

measureDefinitions.name: Timely Response Rate
measureDefinitions.description: Timely Yes Count divided by Known Flag Count; undefined is BLANK.

measureDefinitions.name: Untimely Share
measureDefinitions.description: Untimely No Count divided by Known Flag Count; undefined is BLANK.

measureDefinitions.name: Unknown Flag Rate
measureDefinitions.description: Unknown Flag Count divided by Complaint Count; undefined is BLANK.

measureDefinitions.name: Valid Routing Count
measureDefinitions.description: Frequency of nonnegative valid routing lags.

measureDefinitions.name: Invalid Routing Count
measureDefinitions.description: All complaints minus valid routing frequencies; includes missing and negative lags.

measureDefinitions.name: Median Routing Days
measureDefinitions.expression:
VAR _bins =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days]),
            "__frequency", CALCULATE(SUM('Complaint Cohorts'[Complaint Rows]))),
        KEEPFILTERS('Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Status] = "valid"),
        KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK('Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days])),
        KEEPFILTERS('Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days] >= 0))
VAR _total = SUMX(_bins, [__frequency])
VAR _lowerPosition = INT(DIVIDE(_total + 1, 2))
VAR _upperPosition = INT(DIVIDE(_total + 2, 2))
VAR _cumulative = ADDCOLUMNS(_bins, "__cumulative",
    VAR _day = 'Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days]
    RETURN SUMX(FILTER(_bins, 'Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days] <= _day), [__frequency]))
VAR _lower = MINX(FILTER(_cumulative, [__cumulative] >= _lowerPosition), 'Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days])
VAR _upper = MINX(FILTER(_cumulative, [__cumulative] >= _upperPosition), 'Complaint Cohorts'[Routing Days])
RETURN IF(_total > 0, DIVIDE(_lower + _upper, 2), BLANK())
measureDefinitions.description: Frequency-weighted median of valid lags; averages both middle observations; empty is BLANK.

measureDefinitions.name: Monthly Issue Share
measureDefinitions.description: Issue frequency divided by all issues in current month context; all other filters retained; undefined is BLANK.

measureDefinitions.name: Peer Complaint Count
measureDefinitions.description: Other issues: all-issue total minus current issue selection; company, product, date and geography retained.

measureDefinitions.name: Peer Known Count
measureDefinitions.expression: CALCULATE([Known Flag Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Issue')) - [Known Flag Count]
measureDefinitions.description: Other issues: all-issue total minus current issue selection; company, product, date and geography retained.

measureDefinitions.name: Peer No Count
measureDefinitions.expression: CALCULATE([Untimely No Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Issue')) - [Untimely No Count]
measureDefinitions.description: Other issues: all-issue total minus current issue selection; company, product, date and geography retained.

measureDefinitions.name: Peer Untimely Share
measureDefinitions.description: Other-issue No flags divided by other-issue known flags; undefined is BLANK.
